issue_context.title: Remove #ifs in System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter
issue_context.body:
Related to #39174.

We have some left over #ifs that weren't removed as part of #18862.

See:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/bb597e2f6b4f47f0f3058b12f16a83e4f3b5e6ba/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/ReflectTypeDescriptionProvider.cs#L78-L87

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/bb597e2f6b4f47f0f3058b12f16a83e4f3b5e6ba/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/ReflectTypeDescriptionProvider.cs#L652-L661

and one non-behavior instance that can just be cleaned up:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/bb597e2f6b4f47f0f3058b12f16a83e4f3b5e6ba/src/libraries/System.ComponentModel.TypeConverter/src/System/ComponentModel/Design/StandardCommands.cs#L665-L667

For the first two, we should remove the `#if` and enable the code it is protecting. These are left-over from pre-standard2.0 days when some APIs weren't available. As part of enabling this code we should add unit tests for the behavior.

For the last one, the whole code chunk can be removed since it is not needed.

review_comments:
This is not what I had intended when I wrote the issue.

> For the first two, we should remove the #if and enable the code it is protecting. These are left-over from pre-standard2.0 days when some APIs weren't available. As part of enabling this code we should add unit tests for the behavior.

To be explicit, I meant:

```diff
- #if FEATURE_SKIP_INTERFACE
                typeof(System.Runtime.InteropServices.GuidAttribute),
                typeof(System.Runtime.InteropServices.InterfaceTypeAttribute)
- #endif
```

Which means this code would now look like:

```C#
        private static Type[] InitializeSkipInterfaceAttributeList()
        {
            return new Type[]
            {
                typeof(System.Runtime.InteropServices.GuidAttribute),
                typeof(System.Runtime.InteropServices.InterfaceTypeAttribute)
                typeof(System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComVisibleAttribute),
            };
        }
```

See https://github.com/dotnet/corefx/pull/12977 for how we removed these `#if`s previously.

The added unit tests should tests should fail when using the current product code, and pass with the new changes. They should be testing that `GuidAttribute` and `InterfaceTypeAttribute` are skipped correctly.
